**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Lock the entry while composing appended notes**

If a user/API edit commits after `notes` is read but before `enrich_attribute` saves, this read-modify-write composes its value from stale notes and the later rule save can erase the concurrent edit; it can even do so after that edit has locked `notes`, because the in-memory entry still contains the old lock state. The family advisory lock only serializes rule runners, not transaction edits, so the read, duplicate check, merge, and save should run under an entry row lock with a reload.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
